newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EUROPEAN GOLD BARELY CHANGED IN $323/330 RANGE.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN GOLD BARELY CHANGED IN $323/330 RANGE.

text.p: ZURICH, Aug 12 (Reuter) Gold opened barely changed in Europe, hovering in a slightly firmer range of $323/330 an ounce but looking limited on the upside, traders said.
The market was very quiet and silver was also little changed.
Gold started at $327.35/327.75 after closing in London at $327.20/327.70.
"Gold is a little firmer and supported at the bottom by the fact that it closed higher in New York," one trader said.
Silver opened at $4.43/4.45 versus $4.42/4.44, with the range seen at $4.40/4.48.
Platinum was down $8 at $436.00/439.00. Proft-taking after Friday's highs weakened the metal but supplies were thin, limiting the downside, traders said.
